A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a study of intersections with marked Trunk Highway 23 in the city of Rockville.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; STUDY. +]

[+(a) $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation to study options for the following intersections in the city of Rockville: +]

[+(1) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 47; +]

[+(2) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 82; and +]

[+(3) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County Road 140. +]

[+(b) The study must determine if an underpass, overpass, or tunnel is the best option for improving the safety of each intersection. The study must not consider a J-turn as an option. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a study of intersections with marked Trunk Highway 23 in the city of Rockville.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; STUDY.

(a) $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation to study options for the following intersections in the city of Rockville:

(1) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 47;

(2) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 82; and

(3) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County Road 140.

(b) The study must determine if an underpass, overpass, or tunnel is the best option for improving the safety of each intersection. The study must not consider a J-turn as an option. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: (a) $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation to study options for the following intersections in the city of Rockville:
(1) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 47;
(2) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County State-Aid Highway 82; and
(3) marked Trunk Highway 23 and Stearns County Road 140.

(b) The study must determine if an underpass, overpass, or tunnel is the best option for improving the safety of each intersection. The study must not consider a J-turn as an option. This is a onetime appropriation.
